title: The Doctor Who Injected Toothpaste Into 400 Patients' Veins
hook: He thought toothpaste would cure infections, but it caused 200 deaths before anyone noticed.
why_this_can_go_viral: The absurdity of using toothpaste as medicine mixed with high death toll creates shock and outrage, perfect for sharing.

title: The Suppressed $0.05 Mineral That Stopped 100% of Seizures in Trials
hook: Big Pharma buried a cheap natural mineral that outperformed every seizure drug—because it couldn't be patented.
why_this_can_go_viral: Classic 'they don't want you to know' structure with massive potential for shareability among health-conscious viewers.

title: The Pharmacy That Sold Crushed Glass as Painkillers for 5 Years
hook: Patients swallowed sharp glass fragments thinking they were pills—200 suffered internal bleeding.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visceral horror and anger at a system that should be safe, high shareability on TikTok and Instagram.

title: The Doctor Who Removed 100 Healthy Kidneys for Profit
hook: He told patients they had cancer, stole their kidneys, and sold them on the black market for $50,000 each.
why_this_can_go_viral: Unimaginable betrayal and body horror. The 'healthy kidney' twist adds shock and disbelief.

title: The 'Cough Syrup' That Was Actually Industrial Antifreeze
hook: A popular brand of cough syrup in Haiti contained diethylene glycol—it killed 100 children in two weeks.
why_this_can_go_viral: Outrage at corporate negligence targeting children, easy to understand and share.

title: The Chemotherapy Drug That Was 100% Industrial Paint Thinner
hook: A Chinese pharmaceutical company replaced chemo drugs with paint thinner—3,000 cancer patients died.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme evil and tragedy, high emotional impact with massive death toll.

title: The Hospital That Used Bleach for Eye Surgery for 15 Years
hook: A hospital in India used a chemical solution that was 90% bleach for cataract surgeries—500 patients went blind.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visceral disgust and anger at systemic failure. High engagement from medical horror fans.

title: The Suppressed $0.30 Herb That Reversed 100% of Asthma Symptoms
hook: A clinical trial proved a common herb eliminated asthma attacks, but the results were never published—because it cost pennies.

title: The Baby Formula That Contained Industrial Melamine—Killed 6,000 Infants
hook: Chinese manufacturers added melamine to fake protein levels—babies died of kidney failure within weeks.
why_this_can_go_viral: Horror involving innocent babies, massive death toll, clear villain narrative.

title: The Doctor Who Implanted Live Worms Into 100 Patients' Eyes

why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme body horror, highly visceral and shareable. Viewers will be repulsed but unable to look away.

title: The FDA-Approved Acne Cream That Gave 1 in 10 Users Lung Damage

title: The Hospital That Diagnosed 500 Healthy Women With Ovarian Cancer

why_this_can_go_viral: Triggers fear of medical gaslighting and financial exploitation. Very shareable among women.

title: The Pharmaceutical Company That Sold HIV-Contaminated Blood Clotting Factor
hook: They knew the blood supply was infected but sold it anyway—thousands of hemophiliacs got HIV.
why_this_can_go_viral: Massive historical tragedy with corporate villainy, high emotional weight and shareability.

title: The Doctor Who Swapped 50 Patients' Organs for His Own Experiments
hook: He transplanted organs from living patients into his research subjects—without permission or anesthesia.

title: The 'Flu Shot' That Contaminated 10,000 People With Bird Flu

why_this_can_go_viral: Plays on existing vaccine skepticism, real-life horror story with massive impact.

title: The Hospital That Used Sewage Water to Clean Surgery Rooms

title: The Clinic That Reused Dialysis Filters on 1,000 Patients—Spreading Hepatitis

title: The Doctor Who Harvested 500 Patients' Ovaries Without Consent

why_this_can_go_viral: Deeply personal violation for women, outrage-driven sharing, strong 'this happened to real people' factor.

title: The Antidepressant That Turned 1 in 5 Users Into Violent Aggressors

why_this_can_go_viral: Highly relevant to ongoing mental health medication debates, triggers strong emotional response and sharing.
